newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran says haj fire breaks out at Iranian camp.
newsitem.headline: Iran says haj fire breaks out at Iranian camp.

text.p: Tents of Iranian pilgrims in Saudi Arabia caught fire on Tuesday and firefighters were battling the blaze, the official Iranian news agency IRNA said.

It did not give any other details. The official Saudi Press Agency (SPA) and witnesses had earlier said a fire broke out at a compound of tents in the plain of Mena near the holy city of Mecca where two million Moslem pilgrims were gathering on Tuesday at the start of the annual haj pilgrimage.
